prompt_template: Forecast whether next week contains at least one red-tide report. Rows are past weeks oldest first. log_reports is log(1+report count); season_sin and season_cos encode the calendar. A zero report is not proof of biological absence. Answer only 1 (one or more reports) or 0 (no reports).
protocol: frozen zero-shot binary token score; pre-test Platt calibration
pretraining_overlap: Public data overlap cannot be excluded. This small LLM does not represent all LLMs.
seed_note: LLM is frozen deterministic; hybrid varies with 3 independently trained Eco models. Not 3 independently trained LLMs.
prompt_selection: One fixed prompt, not test tuned; model choice fixed before comparison.
